name: ENTRANT_TEAMS
description: pointer to the malloc'd list of the 6 national teams (club pointers) of the Oceania Nations Cup, freed and zeroed on the draw day after the group tables
evidence: select_and_draw_teams 0x799e30 allocates 0x18 bytes into +0xee and fills slots 0..5; create_group_table 0x7995a0 reads slots 0..2; update_for_date 0x79a100 frees and zeroes it

name: ENTRANT_TEAM_COUNT
description: number of national teams in ENTRANT_TEAMS (6), zeroed on the draw day
evidence: 0x799e30 writes word 6; 0x79a100 writes word 0 after freeing +0xee
